_about: Registry of every tool the creative hub drives. scripts/hub.ps1 reads this file. To add a tool: add one entry here, one server in .mcp.json, and a line in README.md. VN Studio also reads this file to start pixel-studio, chiptune-studio and comfyui when a job needs them: keep their fields (id, repo, port, mcp, http, managed, warning, startTimeout, start {kind, path, cwd, args, env}); kinds other than electron and exe are ignored for these three.

services.name: Scriptorium (book writer)
services.warning: Starting the engine resumes the book factory: it starts writing every open idea in ~/Scriptorium/ideas, user ideas first, and may use paid models (budget in config/budget.md).

services.name: Book Translator
services.auth: Bearer token from the user env var BOOK_TRANSLATOR_MCP_TOKEN (hub.ps1 setup creates it).

services.name: VibeTTS (Kokoro / Supertonic speech)
services.note: Tray app that autostarts at login. MCP needs [mcp] enabled = true in D:\Programs\VibeTTS\config.toml (Settings > Agents (MCP)).

services.name: ComfyUI (images, music, TTS models)
services.note: Plain HTTP API, no MCP of its own: comfy-mcp (next entry) is its MCP server, and VN Studio calls the API directly. The hub starts the server headless with the same command Comfy Desktop uses (from its app.log); for the graph editor open http://127.0.0.1:8188 or use Comfy Desktop (which then moves to 8199 if the hub's server is up).

services.name: ComfyUI MCP (images, edits, cutouts, music, speech, saved workflows)
services.note: Generates through the comfyui service (8188); it starts without it, and its status tool says when ComfyUI is down. Outputs default to the data folder; every tool takes an absolute out path.

services.name: LM Studio (local LLMs + nomic embeddings)
services.note: OpenAI-compatible API used by Scriptorium (RAG needs nomic-embed-text-v1.5), Book Translator and VN Studio. No MCP needed.

services.name: Strata (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next server)
services.note: Uses most of the GPU memory; run one model at a time. First model in the fallback chain of Scriptorium and Book Translator.

services.name: ACP Proxy (OpenAI-compatible API over Codex, Antigravity and Claude agents)
services.note: An openai-compat provider (id acp, base_url http://127.0.0.1:7461/v1, json_schema false, concurrency 4) for all five apps: Scriptorium, Book Translator, VN Studio, Pixel Studio, Chiptune Studio (HUB-09; Pixel and Chiptune once PAR-14 / MDI-07 merge). Port 7461, not its default 8787 (flow-mcp's panel; set 7461 in the proxy's settings file too). PROXY_IGNORE_SAMPLING needs AAP-05. AAP-25 per-provider FIFO cap: PROXY_MAX_CONCURRENT 4 (codex 4, antigravity 3 here; PROXY_MAX_QUEUE, PROXY_CLAUDE_MAX_CONCURRENT also exist); /healthz shows providers.<id>.{active,queued,max_concurrent,max_queue}. Providers and logins are set in its settings.json or desktop app. Antigravity through it breaks clause 6 of Antigravity's terms: the user accepted that risk (2026-10-22).

services.name: flow-music-mcp (Google Flow and Flow Music: images, video, characters, voices, songs, assembly, captions)
services.note: One MCP for both Google sites (replaces flow-mcp, retired 2026-10-22: Flow was redesigned). Own Chrome profile (~/.flow-music-mcp/chrome-profile, CDP 9334) with a tab per site, opened on the first tool call; sign in once with yarn login. Free: Flow images, Gemini and Windows voices, assembly, captions (own whisper.cpp, installed on first use). Credits: Flow video and Flow voices (max_credits), Flow Music songs. Keys and settings: .env in the repo or ~/.flow-music-mcp/.env (see .env.example).
